LESSON: ART APPRECIATION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: FINE ARTS FOR LEARNERS WITH LOW VISION JUNE
Strand: Indigenous Crafts (3D Art)
Topic 3.5: Art Appreciation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Art Appreciation, part of Indigenous Crafts (3D Art) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 FINE ARTS FOR LEARNERS WITH LOW VISION JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important for practicing artists to know legal issues affecting the production of artwork?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Art Appreciation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: Is enhanced as the learner actively participates in research and discussion on legal issues

• Digital literacy: The skill of using new technology is exhibited as the learner uses digital devices to conduct research

and prepare slides on the importance of marketing artworks online

• Self-efficacy: The skill of self-confidence is acquired as the learner presents and discusses the legal issues in class.

Values:
• Respect: Learner appreciates others’ opinions as they present and discuss the slides in class.

• Unity: Learner collaborates with peers as they present and discuss the slides in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Citizenship Education: Learner appreciates the need to uphold integrity when creating and marketing artworks.

• Financial literacy: Learner formulates strategies of marketing artworks online
